versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Qwen TTS Realtime integration.

- Provides low-latency, real-time speech synthesis using specific Qwen TTS models.
- Supports instruction-controlled and standard real-time TTS.
- Includes SDK setup, environment requirements, and compatibility probe/demo scripts.
- Documents both required and optional API parameters for normalized requests and responses.
- Offers operational guidance and output management options.
